card.name: Linking words before stimulant or drug-class names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as other, either, such, as, a and of that come just before a drug class name like amphetamine products or stimulants. Also the end of beta-lactam before antibiotics.

modes.label: Other/either before drug
modes.description: The word other or either points to another drug of the same kind, right before the class noun.
modes.example: in patients treated with<< other>> amphetamine products [see ADVERSE RE

modes.label: Inside beta-lactam
modes.description: The last piece of beta-lactam just before the word antibiotics.
modes.example: CROSS-SENSITIVITY AMONG ß-LACT<<AM>> ANTIBIOTICS HAS BEEN CLEAR

card.writes: No clear meaning in the promoted tokens, but it lowers combination-type words, so it may steer the next word toward a class noun.
card.plain: It fires on little words right before a drug group name, such as other amphetamine products or a stimulant.
